home.heroTitle: A ready workspace in Alexandria. Book and pay in minutes.
home.heroLead: Private offices and dedicated desks by the month, hot desks by the day, meeting rooms by the hour.
points: Instant confirmation for hot desks and meeting rooms
Your invoice arrives by email after every booking
You pay on a secure page and we never store your card
home.spacesLead: Prices and availability come live from the Flux system and update as soon as the team changes them.
home.flowsTitle: Two clear paths, depending on the space

instantSteps.title: Pick a space and time
instantSteps.text: We show only the times that are free, and any add-ons you can book with it.

instantSteps.title: Pay on the secure page
instantSteps.text: We hold your slot for 15 minutes while you pay. If the time runs out, the slot is released.

instantSteps.title: Get your confirmation and invoice
instantSteps.text: Your booking is confirmed automatically after payment, and the invoice is in your account.

requestSteps.title: Send your request
requestSteps.text: Space type, start date and term, with the documents that identify your business.

requestSteps.title: Our team reviews it
requestSteps.text: We contact you about the deposit and invoice, following our usual process.

requestSteps.title: Your booking is confirmed
requestSteps.text: Follow the status and invoices in your account, and pay by the methods we accept.

detail.cancellationText: You can cancel online from your account up to 24 hours before the start time. If you cancel after paying, we record a refund request and our team handles it.

packages.title: Packages
packages.lead: Prepaid hours and days for meeting rooms and hot desks. Once you hold a package, you can apply it online to any booking it covers in full.
how: Our team sets up your package after you ask. You pay by cash, bank transfer, card machine, Instapay or mobile wallet.
Your balance and a QR code for reception appear in your account.
At checkout, a package that covers the booking in full confirms it with no payment. Otherwise you pay the full price.
packages.empty: No packages are listed right now. Contact us to ask about options.
